metadata.methods_description: Subjects were presented with bursts of pink or white noise from loudspeakers positioned at various elevations within a hemi-anechoic chamber. In Experiment I (deviant detection), subjects heard an adapter sound followed by a probe sound, with EEG and behavioral responses (button presses to deviants) recorded. In Experiment II (one-back task), subjects heard white noise through open headphones followed by a burst from a loudspeaker at a specific elevation, with target trials requiring localization judgments. A subset of subjects in Experiment II completed a second session with ear molds disrupting elevation perception.
